content.title: Grundfos 401-1396 Centrifugal Pump, 1.5 in Outlet, 200 L/min Max Flow
content.short_description: Grundfos 401-1396 is a centrifugal pump with a 1.5 in outlet and a maximum flow rate of 200 L/min, intended for industrial fluid handling applications.
content.long_description:
The Grundfos 401-1396 is a centrifugal pump designed for industrial fluid handling systems. It features a 1.5 in outlet connection and delivers a maximum flow rate of 200 L/min, making it suitable for applications requiring consistent fluid transfer at this capacity range.

As a centrifugal pump, the 401-1396 uses rotational energy from an impeller to move fluid through the system, a design commonly specified for continuous-duty pumping tasks in industrial settings. The 1.5 in outlet size should be matched against existing piping and connection specifications prior to installation.

Procurement and maintenance teams should confirm the 200 L/min max flow rate against system demand curves and process requirements before specifying this pump for a given application.
